title: ClimateGuard AI - Main Dashboard
prompt:
Create the flagship ClimateGuard AI Main Dashboard screen adhering strictly to the established design system tokens (#07111F canvas, #0B1728 sidebar/navbar, #101F33 cards, #22D3EE primary cyan, #3B82F6 blue, #EF4444 critical, #F97316 high, #EAB308 moderate, #22C55E low).

The inner content inside the dashboard main container should have 28px padding and feature:

1. Top Dashboard Header & Controls:
- Breadcrumb: Telemetry Operations > Mission Overview
- Page Title: "Climate Intelligence Command" with subtitle "Multi-hazard telemetry synthesis, MapLibre geospatial monitoring & automated disaster finance orchestration"
- Right controls:
  - Basin / Zone selector dropdown (e.g., "All Monitored Basins (18 Active)")
  - Time Horizon Filter: "Live Telemetry (Real-time)" with indicator
  - API Sync & Refresh action button with pulsing cyan sync icon and "Last sync: 2m ago (Open-Meteo & Copernicus)"
  - "Simulate Scenario" ghost button

2. Top Row: 4 Climate KPI Telemetry Cards:
- Card 1: Active Risk Zones: "18 Monitored" (Sub-breakdown: 4 Critical, 6 High Anomaly, 8 Nominal) with globe radar icon and +2 vs last 24h.
- Card 2: Flood Inundation Index: "Critical Alert" with metric "88% Threat" (Rio Paraná & Indus Basin NW, River discharge 14,200 m³/s, +18% vs 10yr baseline) in red alert styling (#EF4444).
- Card 3: Extreme Heat Stress: "76% Index" (Rajasthan & Sindh Corridor, Peak ambient 46.2°C, WBGT 31.8°C wet bulb) in high warning orange styling (#F97316).
- Card 4: Drought & Aridity Deficit: "64% Deficit" (Horn of Africa Zone 4, Root-zone soil moisture 11.4%, -41% vs seasonal norm) in amber warning styling (#EAB308).

3. Main Analytical Grid (2-Column Balanced Layout):
Left Column (65% width):
- Section: "Geospatial Threat Matrix (MapLibre WebGL Viewport)"
  - Header with MapLibre GL Integration badge, Layer toggles (Flood Extent, FIRMS Fire, Thermal Infrared, Soil Desiccation), Opacity slider (80%), Projection toggle (EPSG:3857 / 3D Globe), Fullscreen icon.
  - Interactive Map Container: High-detail dark cartographic styling with grid lines, latitude/longitude markings (e.g. 25.5°S 54.5°W), vector river networks, pulsing hazard nodes with interactive tooltips (Paraná Critical Flood 88%, Rajasthan Thermal Wave 76%, Horn of Africa Desiccation 64%), and map legend in lower corner with scale bar and MapLibre GL attribution.
  - Quick Map Telemetry bar underneath: Active Satellites (Sentinel-2, GPM IMERG, ERA5), Sensor cross-validation 99.4%, Inundation boundary calculated.

- Section: "Hydro-Meteorological Telemetry (48h Real-Time vs Forecast)"
  - Dual-axis visual chart showing Temperature (°C) in cyan curve, Rainfall (mm) in stacked/filled blue area, and Relative Humidity (%) in muted dashed curve with a "NOW" dividing line showing historical vs projected 24h.
  - Mini stats pill footer: Precip peak 68.4 mm/hr, Ambient max 46.2°C, Vapor Pressure Deficit 3.82 kPa.

Right Column (35% width):
- Section: "Global Hazard Risk Distribution"
  - Donut chart graphic with center label "18 Basins": Inundation / Flash Flood (42%, 8 Basins), Thermal Stress & Heatwave (31%, 6 Basins), Agricultural Aridity / Drought (27%, 4 Basins).
  - Severity Stratification bar: Critical (4), High (7), Moderate (7).

- Section: "Automated Parametric Trigger Ledger"
  - Header with "Simulation Only" badge and "Solvency Pool: $42.5M".
  - Active triggers quick list:
    * CG-FIN-9821: Lower Mekong Flash Flood v2 ($5,000,000 - Triggered / Pending Multi-Sig)
    * CG-FIN-9818: Northern Kenya NDVI Drought ($8,000,000 - Executed 4.1h ago)
    * CG-FIN-9755: Jacobabad Thermal Health Action ($1,200,000 - Simulated Approved)
  - Action button: "Open Disaster Finance Vault →"

- Section: "API Synchronization & Pipeline Health"
  - Live data provider status grid:
    * Open-Meteo API: Operational (Latency 142ms, synced 2m ago)
    * NASA GIBS / FIRMS: Operational (Orbital swath v4.8, synced 8m ago)
    * Copernicus ERA5 Reanalysis: Operational (synced 15m ago)
    * Multi-Sig Parametric Escrow: Testnet Verified (Sepolia Block #9,481,204)

4. Bottom Section: "Active Incident Feed & Automated Response Log"
- Filterable enterprise table:
  - Headers: Incident ID, Monitored Region, Hazard Indicator, Risk Severity, Sensor Telemetry / Threshold, Detected UTC, Parametric Status, Action.
  - 5 realistic sample rows with clean badges, clear data values, and "Inspect Telemetry" button.
- Pagination footer showing "Showing 1-5 of 48 incidents | Cryptographic Merkle Root 0x8f...39a1 verified".

Ensure pixel-perfect visual hierarchy, crisp contrast, 1px #24364B borders, and exact design system alignment.
